rules.expr:
sum(count_over_time(
  {log_format="json", runtime="container", service="frontend"}
  | label_format m3_json_ok=`{{ $o := fromJson (__line__) }}{{ if eq (printf "%T" $o) "map[string]interface {}" }}{{ if and (eq (printf "%T" (index $o "request_uri")) "string") }}true{{end}}{{end}}`
  | m3_json_ok="true"
  | json m3_uri="request_uri"
  | __error__="" | m3_uri!=""
  | label_format m3_decoded=`{{ .m3_uri | urldecode }}`
  | __error__=""
  | m3_decoded=~"(?is).*(?:\\bunion(?:\\s|/\\*[^*]*\\*/)+(?:all(?:\\s|/\\*[^*]*\\*/)+)?select\\b|\\b(?:or|and)\\s+(?:1\\s*=\\s*1\\b|'1'\\s*=\\s*'1'|\\\"1\\\"\\s*=\\s*\\\"1\\\")|\\b(?:pg_sleep|sleep|extractvalue|updatexml)\\s*\\(|\\binformation_schema\\b|;\\s*(?:drop|alter|truncate)\\s+table\\b).*"
  | drop m3_json_ok, m3_uri, m3_decoded
  [2m]
)) > 0

sum(count_over_time(
  {log_format="json", runtime="host", service="db"}
  | label_format m3_json_ok=`{{ $o := fromJson (__line__) }}{{ if eq (printf "%T" $o) "map[string]interface {}" }}{{ if and (eq (printf "%T" (index $o "error_severity")) "string") (eq (printf "%T" (index $o "state_code")) "string") (eq (printf "%T" (index $o "message")) "string") }}true{{end}}{{end}}`
  | m3_json_ok="true"
  | json m3_severity="error_severity", m3_code="state_code", m3_message="message"
  | __error__=""
  | m3_severity="FATAL" | m3_code="53300"
  | m3_message=~"(?i)^(sorry, too many clients already|remaining connection slots are reserved for .+)$"
  | drop m3_json_ok, m3_severity, m3_code, m3_message
  [2m]
)) > 0
pg_stat_activity_count > 40
rate(nginx_http_requests_total{job="nginx-exporter"}[1m]) > 30
